<file path="source.py">

class BaseNotifier(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    send(self, message: str) -> None

class EmailNotifier(BaseNotifier):
    from_address = from_address
    __init__(self, smtp_host: str, port: int, from_address: str)
    @property
    connection_info(self) -> str
    send(self, message: str) -> None
</file>
